journey.metaDescription: Understand the four stages of coordination with HEALIX MEDICAL, from first contact to travel arrangements, and which decisions remain with the medical team.
journey.title: The patient journey
journey.lead: A transparent overview of how coordination works. These stages describe our process; they do not guarantee timelines, acceptance or results.

steps.title: Initial contact
steps.text: You send a short enquiry with your name, country, preferred language, contact method and the service you are asking about. We do not request medical documents at this stage.

steps.title: Clarifying the need
steps.text: A coordinator contacts you to understand your request in non-medical terms: who the patient is, who is supporting them and what you hope to learn.

steps.title: Coordinating with the medical provider
steps.text: If you choose to continue, we coordinate communication with a suitable medical provider. When medical files are requested, they are shared through a separate secure channel with your consent.

steps.title: Travel arrangements and follow-up
steps.text: After the medical provider gives its guidance, travel and follow-up arrangements are discussed according to the service available and the scope confirmed for your case.

about.metaTitle: About HEALIX MEDICAL – International Patient Coordination
about.metaDescription: HEALIX MEDICAL is a patient coordination company working with international patients seeking medical services in Türkiye. Learn about our role and principles.
about.title: About HEALIX MEDICAL
about.lead: HEALIX MEDICAL coordinates the journey of international patients who are exploring medical services in Türkiye.
about.imageAlt: A male coordinator on a phone call at a desk in a bright office
role: Travelling abroad for medical care involves many questions: where to start, whom to contact and how to share information safely. Our role is to make this first part of the journey clearer and more organised.

We are a coordination company, not a hospital. Diagnosis, eligibility, treatment decisions and medical care are the responsibility of licensed hospitals and medical teams. We do not promise outcomes, acceptance, costs or durations.

faqPage.metaDescription: Answers to general questions about contacting HEALIX MEDICAL, our coordination role, website languages, privacy and travel to Türkiye.
faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.lead: General, non-medical information. Questions about diagnosis, eligibility, treatment or organ donation law must be answered by the medical team and competent authorities.

items.a: HEALIX MEDICAL coordinates communication and the patient journey for international patients seeking medical services in Türkiye. We are not a hospital and do not provide medical care.
Use the short contact form to send your name, country, preferred language, contact method and the service you are asking about. A coordinator will contact you using the method you chose.

items.q: Should I send my medical reports through the website?
items.a: No. The website form is only for a first enquiry. If a medical provider later needs records, a separate secure channel will be explained to you, including who can access the files.

items.q: Who decides whether I can be treated?
items.a: Only the licensed hospital and medical team can decide on diagnosis, eligibility and treatment after their own evaluation.

items.q: Can you tell me the cost or duration of treatment?
items.a: Costs and durations depend on the medical provider's evaluation. We do not publish or guarantee final costs or timelines.

items.q: Which languages is the website available in?
items.a: The website is available in Arabic, English, French, Russian and Turkish. Ask us which languages are available for direct communication in your case.

items.q: Can a family member contact you on behalf of a patient?
items.a: Yes. A family member can send the first enquiry. Medical information about the patient should only be shared later with the patient's consent.

items.q: Do you arrange travel and accommodation?
items.a: Travel-related arrangements are discussed only where they are part of the coordination scope confirmed for a specific case. We will tell you clearly what is and is not included.

items.q: Is HEALIX MEDICAL an emergency service?
items.a: No. In an urgent or emergency situation, contact your local emergency services immediately.

privacy.metaDescription: How HEALIX MEDICAL handles contact enquiries, what data the website collects, and our approach to cookies and advertising tools.
privacy.title: Privacy & cookie policy

p: This website is operated by HEALIX MEDICAL, a company that coordinates the journey of international patients seeking medical services in Türkiye.

sections.h: What we collect through the website
p: The contact form collects only: your name, country, preferred language, preferred contact method and contact details, the service area you are asking about, and your consent to be contacted.
The form does not ask for diagnoses, medical reports, images or medical history, and it does not allow file uploads. Please do not include such information in the form.
We use these details only to respond to your enquiry and to coordinate the next steps you request. We do not sell your data.
If a medical provider later needs your medical records, they will be shared through a separate secure channel, only after your consent and after we explain who can access them.

This website does not currently use analytics or advertising cookies, and it does not use the Meta Pixel or similar tracking tools. Links to Instagram and Facebook are simple links; those platforms apply their own policies when you visit them.

If analytics or advertising tools are introduced in the future, this policy will be updated first and any required consent will be requested. Health-related information, form contents and the service you ask about will never be sent to advertising platforms.

Enquiry details are kept only as long as needed to handle your request and meet legal obligations. They are shared with a medical provider only when needed to coordinate your request and with your agreement.

Depending on the applicable law, including the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK) where relevant, you may have the right to request access to, correction or deletion of your personal data. You can make such a request through our official contact channels.

terms.metaDescription: Terms for using the HEALIX MEDICAL website, including the nature of our coordination service and the limits of website information.
terms.title: Terms of use

p: This website introduces HEALIX MEDICAL and allows visitors to send a first enquiry. It is not a hospital website, a booking platform or an online shop.
HEALIX MEDICAL coordinates communication and the patient journey. Diagnosis, eligibility, treatment decisions and medical care are the responsibility of licensed hospitals and medical teams.
Sending an enquiry does not create a medical relationship and does not guarantee acceptance by any medical provider, treatment results, costs or durations.
Content on this website is general information and may be updated. It is not medical advice and must not replace consultation with a qualified doctor.
Links to external platforms such as Instagram or Facebook are provided for convenience. We are not responsible for the content or policies of those platforms.
We may update these terms. The version published on this page applies from its publication date.

disclaimer.metaDescription: HEALIX MEDICAL is a patient coordination company. Website content is general information and not a substitute for medical advice.
disclaimer.title: Medical disclaimer

p: HEALIX MEDICAL is not a hospital or a medical provider. We do not diagnose, treat, prescribe or perform procedures.
Service descriptions on this website are general and educational. They are not a diagnosis or a recommendation and are not a substitute for consultation with a doctor.
Diagnosis, eligibility, treatment plans, risks and follow-up are determined only by licensed hospitals and medical teams after their own evaluation.
We do not guarantee acceptance of a case, treatment success, final costs or treatment duration.
Questions about organ donation, donor eligibility and related legal requirements are answered exclusively by the medical provider and competent authorities under applicable law.
HEALIX MEDICAL is not an emergency service. In an emergency, contact your local emergency services immediately.
